title: Administration Fee on Recurring Self-Help — Community Rules & Site Care Fee Schedule
content:
The administration fee of a self-help charge under Community Rules & Site Care rises with the self-help charges already on the plan record's statement dated within the 12 calendar months ending on the handling date.

| Self-help charges already on the statement, dated within the 12 calendar months ending on the handling date | Administration fee |
|---|---|
| two or more | $60.00 |
| exactly one | $45.00 |
| none | the plan's self-help administration fee |

## Reading the schedule

- The count takes in only self-help charges already on the statement, dated within the 12 calendar months ending on the handling date; an older self-help charge is not counted.
- **Hypothetical case.** A record whose statement carries one self-help charge dated four months before the handling date carries an administration fee of $45.00 on the next self-help charge; with a second such charge in the window, the fee is $60.00.
- **Hypothetical case.** A record whose only earlier self-help charge is dated 14 months before the handling date counts none, and the administration fee is the plan's self-help administration fee.
